verses.1: And the sons of Reuben were given possession of the land of Israel. They were the heirs to their father’s estate. But they were not to be considered as heirs to the entire land of Israel. Instead, they were to be given a portion of the land as inheritance by the sons of Joseph, son of Israel.
verses.2: For Judah is greater than his brothers, and he will rule over them. He will also be the one who will lead them.
verses.3: The sons of Reuben, in the land of Israel, planted vineyards and orchards.
verses.4: The sons of Joel, Shma’ya, Gog, Shimi, and Beno.
verses.5: Michah son of Reaiah, son of Baal.
verses.6: In the land of his son, who was the king of Philistia. He was the ancestor of Reuben.
verses.7: And his brothers, who were his family members, took care of their mothers. The first ones were Yehiyael and Zekhariyah.
verses.8: And Belah, son of Azaz, son of Shema, son of Yoel… He will sit in the throne and rule over Nebo and over the people of Moab.
verses.9: And in the east, they will remain until they come out of the desert along the river Euphrates. For their possessions became numerous in the land of Gilad.
verses.10: And in the days of Saul, they fought against the Hagars. They were defeated by them, and they had to settle in their camps, on all sides of the sunrise, forever.
verses.11: And the children of Gad will dwell opposite them in the land of darkness, until the end of time.
verses.12: May he who is the head come, and may he who changes speech speak. May he judge in righteousness.
verses.13: And they went into their homes in their ancestors’ houses: Mikhael, Mashlam, Seba, Yori, Yaakan, Ziyah, and Eber.
verses.14: These are the sons of Abiiah, son of Huri, son of Yaroh, son of Gilad, son of Mikhael, son of Yeshishai, son of Yahdod, and son of Buz.
verses.15: My brother, son of Avdiyel, son of Guni, be the leader of their ancestors’ house.
verses.16: And they settled in Gilad, in Bashan and its surrounding areas, and in all the valleys of Sharon, along their borders.
verses.17: They all lived during the time of King Josiah of Judah, and also during the time of King Jeroboam of Israel.
verses.18: Bnei Reuben, Gadiel, and half of the men from the tribe of Manashe. These were men who could carry shields and weapons. There were also forty thousand soldiers who were trained for war.
verses.19: And they fought against the Hagriams, Vitur, Napish, and Nodav.
verses.20: And they were helped by them. They were given the weapons in their hands, along with everything else they had. For they cried out to God during the battle, and he protected them, because they trusted in him.
verses.21: And they took back from their homes their garments, fifty thousand each; also sheep and lambs, fifty thousand each. And there were also fifty thousand men, with a total of one hundred thousand people.
verses.22: Many idols fell because of the war between God and those who worshipped them. They remained trapped beneath those idols until they were destroyed.
verses.23: And the sons of Chevi Shevet Manehesh will dwell in the land from Bashan to Baal Hermon. And the mountains of Hermon are numerous.
verses.24: And these are the leaders of their families: Efrayim, Yishai, Eliyal, Azriyal, Yirmiya, Hodoya, and Yahdial. They are men of great importance, people who belong to the ranks of those who are considered “great” in their own communities.
verses.25: And they worshipped their own ancestors. They also worshiped the gods of the people of this land, who were those who God had destroyed from among them.
verses.26: And the God of Israel drove out the spirit of King Ashur, as well as the spirit of King Tiglath-Pileser. He also drove them away from Ravan, Gad, and half of the tribe of Manasseh. They were brought to Chalchab, Habor, Haro, and Nahar Gazon, all the way up to this day.
verses.27: The sons of Levi were Gershon, Kehat, and Merari.
verses.28: And the sons of Khat: Amram, Yizhar, Heveron, and Uziel.
verses.29: And the sons of Amram were Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron were Nadab and Abihu.
verses.30: Elisha was born in Pinchas. Pinchas, in turn, was born from Abishua.
verses.31: And Avishua will give birth to Buki; and Buki will give birth to Uziy.
verses.32: And Uzi lived in Zerahya, and Zerahya lived in Merayot.
verses.33: Meroyot gave birth to Amariah, and Amariah gave birth to Ahitub.
verses.34: And Ahitub became the father of Zadok, and Zadok became the father of Ahimeas.
verses.35: And Ahimeas will bear children, and Azariah will also have children. And Azariah will bear children for Joshua.
verses.36: And Jonathan was the son of Azariah, who was the priest in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.
verses.37: And Azariah gave birth to Amariah, and Amariah gave birth to Ahitub.
verses.38: And Ahitub begot Zadok, and Zadok begot Shalum.
verses.39: And Shalom gave birth to Chiliyah, and Chiliyah gave birth to Azariyah.
verses.40: And Azariah begot Sarahiah, and Sarahiah begot Yehoshadak.
verses.41: And he would truly bring about the revelation of Jehovah to Judah and Jerusalem, through Nebuchadnezzar’s hands.
